description: pt-1: put a private claim on the ledger without sending it. Your team encrypts the payload at rest with a team-held key (cs private claim) and sends only commitment = sha256("csp-1" 0x00 blind_hex 0x00 canon(payload)). Optional Ed25519 signature over canon({scheme: "csp-1", commitment}) with key_id. Refuses any payload field. Needs your API key. Never counts as verified.

envelope.description: pq-1: optional opaque cs-enc-v2 hybrid post-quantum envelope (sealed with /sdk/private-v2.mjs; claim_id must be privateIdFor(commitment)); stored as ciphertext only

name: submit_private_commitment
title: File a private claim (hash only)
